spec_features.evidence: give_up is a declared tool (harness.py tool_schemas() ~line 64), dispatched in Sandbox.execute (harness.py ~line 119 returns 'Acknowledged. Stopping.'), and honored as a stop in run_rollout: 'if call.name == "give_up": gave_up = True' then 'if gave_up: transcript.stop_reason = "give_up"; break' (harness.py ~lines 283-305). The break actually ends the loop.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: model can call it, it is detected, and it terminates the rollout. The subject is also told in SYSTEM_PROMPT to call give_up if it concludes the task cannot be completed.

spec_features.spec_quote: A rollout stops on: the category turn budget
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:272 'for turn_index in range(task.turn_budget):' bounds the loop; the for/else sets transcript.stop_reason = "turn_budget" at harness.py:312 when the budget is exhausted. turn_budget originates from config DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS (config.py:16-22) and the TaskManifest (build.py:29).
spec_features.notes: Per-category budgets (3/3/3/30/5). Enforced as the loop's range bound.

spec_features.feature_name: model_stop (prose with no tool calls after turn 0)
spec_features.spec_quote: an assistant turn with prose but no tool calls (`stop_reason="model_stop"`)
spec_features.evidence: harness.py ~lines 306-310: 'if not result.tool_calls and turn_index > 0: transcript.stop_reason = "model_stop"; break'. The break ends the rollout.
spec_features.notes: Narrowed to turn_index > 0 (won't fire on the opening planning message), but the feature as specified ('after turn 0') is fully enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Model produced only prose with no action; treat as natural stop only / if it isn't the first turn (avoid stopping before any work).
